_conventions.acts: act names from the act lists (Overgrowth / Underdocks = act index 0, Hive = 1, Glory = 2) or 'shared' (Models/ModelDb.cs AllSharedEvents)
_conventions.condition: IsAllowed in machine form; act keys use the game's 0-based CurrentActIndex (min_act, max_act, act), min_gold, min_hp (current HP), max_hp_frac (current/max), min_floor (TotalFloor), min_potions, min_tradable_relics, min_removable, min_transformable, min_basic_strikes, min_basic_defends, has_basic, no_event_pet, deck_enchantable (an enchantment id; approximated as true)
_conventions.effects: applied in order; see agent/events.py VOCAB. gold [lo, hi] is an inclusive uniform integer range. Event gold is not scaled by Poverty (A3 scales only encounter and treasure gold); no event reads the ascension level
_conventions.labels: English option titles from localization/eng/events.json in SlayTheSpire2.pck; {Var} is filled at runtime (match as a wildcard)
_conventions.excluded: the 8 ancients (Darv, Neow, Nonupeipe, Orobas, Pael, Tanx, Tezcatara, Vakuu), TheArchitect (the final-act story event, in no pool), Deprecated*
